text: In 1983, four members of the Alabama State Textbook Committee called for the rejection of Maya Angelou's I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings. They claimed the book preached “bitterness and hatred toward white people” and encouraged “deviant behavior” through references to lesbianism, premarital sex and profanity. In 2016 the memoir was among the titles barred by Kuwait's Ministry of Information.
